propositions: The deprecated bare env var REBAR_LLM_MODEL (deprecated in v0.11.0, shipped v0.11.0) must be removed from the resolver and all prose sites describing it as live.

A still-set REBAR_LLM_MODEL env var must fail loud with a RemovedInputError tombstone check in LLMConfig.from_env, not be silently ignored, to prevent undetected model changes that affect cost and quality.
The config key [tool.rebar.llm].model, CLI override -c llm.model, and per-step workflow model: override must remain functional and unaffected by the env var removal.
Model resolution precedence must become CLI > [tool.rebar.llm].model > DEFAULT_MODEL (no env channel) after deletion of _deprecated_bare_model() and its fallback_default rung.

All 15+ test files that reference REBAR_LLM_MODEL and build LLMConfig must be retargeted to surviving resolution channels (config table, per-class env vars, or CLI overrides) to prevent RemovedInputError.

Generated and hand-written documentation (docs/env-vars.md, docs/config.md, infra/runbooks/review-bot-ops.md, infra/compose/docker-compose.yml, etc.) must be updated to reflect removal rather than deprecation.
